title: Russian Banderol Missiles Kill 10 in Kharkiv Region's Pechenihy, Wound 5 in Izyum
detail: Russian forces struck the village of Pechenihy in Kharkiv region with two Banderol missiles — small, jet-powered cruise missiles — early on August 18, killing 10 people and wounding at least 18 in a residential area at a busy intersection lined with a post office, shops, and homes. Ten private homes, a cafe, a post office, a store, and at least seven vehicles were damaged or destroyed. A separate strike on nearby Izyum wounded 5 people, including a 9-year-old boy. The attack came as part of a wider overnight barrage in which Russia launched 147 drones (Shahed, Gerbera, and Parodiya decoys among them) at Ukraine, with Ukrainian air defenses downing 111; Russian drones also struck Brovary in Kyiv region, sparking fires that damaged an office building and warehouses. President Zelensky called it a 'brutal attack' and pledged Ukraine 'will definitely respond.'

title: Ukraine Launches Largest Drone Barrage on Moscow Region in Years, 620+ Drones
detail: Ukraine launched more than 620 long-range drones at Moscow region overnight into August 18 in one of its largest air assaults of the war, according to Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin, who said 180 drones were destroyed over Moscow Oblast (Russia's Defense Ministry claimed 791 downed across 13 regions). Drones struck a Wildberries e-commerce logistics warehouse — already hit in a prior August 16 attack — with reports of billions of rubles in losses, along with a residential building in Pavlovsky Posad, a chemical plant in Orekhovo-Zuyevo, a shopping center in Kolomna, and facilities in Elektrostal and Lyubertsy. Three people were wounded in Moscow region. Russian state media TASS described it as the largest drone attack on Moscow in two years.
